Cc: contracts@priotech.com
Date: 2027-05-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + ask: early-commit incentive

Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We ran the pilot evaluation with our product team and they were impressed with latency and the custom prompt routing. We want to move to a formal mutual action plan (MAP) to hit a June close, and have a joint ask: conditional discount tied to an "early commit" milestone. High level:

- Target: $300k ARR commit, 12-month term
- MAP milestone A (30 days): production pilot complete (10% discount applied at invoice 1)
- MAP milestone B (60 days): 50% of committed usage ramped (additional 5% credit)
- Close timeline: sign by 2027-06-15

Attached is a one-page MAP (Priotech_MAP_v1.pdf) plus a draft SOW the legal team wants to align on. Our procurement lead (contracts@priotech.com) asked if Redwood can provide an approval path for any discount beyond standard T&Cs — they'll need VP/CFO confirmation for anything >12% effective discount.

Can you confirm your internal approval chain and approximate lead time to get signoff? If we can get an exec-level email confirming the conditional credits, we can accelerate.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-min call this afternoon.

Cheers,
Elaine Foster
Head of Platform Integrations
Priotech

Elaine —

Thanks for the clear MAP — and congrats to your team on how fast the pilot moved. We can support the structure you suggested with conditional credits tied to measurable ramp metrics. A couple of notes from our side:

- Internal approval: for discounts up to 10% our sales team can approve; 10–20% requires VP signoff; anything >20% needs CFO signoff and in exceptional cases the CEO signs off.
- Timing: expect ~3 business days for VP review, ~5–7 business days for CFO review depending on calendar. We can prep an exec summary to speed that route.
- Contingencies: credits applied as invoice-level credits applied after verification of ramp metrics (billing week boundary) to avoid double-counting.

Next steps from Redwood: Ben (cc'd) will draft the discount authorization request and Marissa will validate SOW commercial language with legal. If you can confirm the exact target commit number and preferred invoice schedule (monthly/quarterly) we'll include that in the authorization packet.

I'll hold a 3pm PT slot for a short call if that helps.

Best,
